text:
maya: heads-up — staging p99 jumped ~25% right after we onboarded model v5.2 (checkpoint + tokenizer change). Noticed at 09:12 UTC. :eyes:
rahul: saw this too. CI perf job failed with a clear regression in kernel selection time slice around step 1200. attaching small excerpt of perf log:
rahul: ```
[09:11:58] kernel_selector: picked kernel=matmul_fused_async (score=0.82)
[09:11:58] kernel_selector: pick_latency=18.4ms  // normally ~3-4ms
[09:12:02] kvcache: eviction_rate=0.47  // baseline ~0.02
```
zach: kv eviction spike looks bad — can we confirm tokenizer changed tokens-per-request distribution? v5.2 tokenizer adds suffix markers which blow up average seq length for short prompts.
maya: yep, token hist shifted: median tokens/request went 6 -> 11 after onboarding. That's probably tripping batching heuristics and kernel heuristics that optimize for short sequences.
lee: if batching heuristics mis-estimate sequence distribution we can end up selecting a kernel optimized for long sequences but pay warmup/alloc penalties. Suggest we bisect tokenizer PR and the runtime change separately.
maya: started a quick bisect: disabling tokenizer suffixing in staging (rollback patch) — metric ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: deploy started by maya for rollback/tokenizer-suffix-disable to staging (deploy-id: dpl-8792).
rahul: while that runs, I'm going to instrument kernel_selector to log candidate scores + reason_code for picks in staging so we can see why matmul_fused_async was preferred. If we have candidate reasons we can adjust tiebreaker thresholds.
zach: also enable kvcache debug sampling for a few requests to see key growth pattern. I suspect the tokenizer suffixing produced many near-unique prefixes so kv hits collapsed.
maya: rollback done — staging p99 back to baseline within 3 minutes. confirms tokenizer suffixing is primary culprit.
lee: ok blocker confirmed. Action items: 1) revert tokenizer suffixing for v5.2 on staged rollout (PR #5443 revert queued), 2) add kernel_selector telemetry (rahul), 3) add qps-weighted token-length histogram to onboarding checks (zach), 4) update rollout policy to pause on >15% p99 delta (maya).
rahul: created telemetry PR #5448 — adds candidate_score and pick_reason to kernel logs and emits a diagnostic trace header so we can correlate with request samples.
zach: created test harness to replay sampled requests against different tokenizers to measure kv hit rates locally. early run shows kv hit drop from 0.94 -> 0.23 for short prompt mix with suffixes.
lee: marking this as rollout-blocker. I’ll hold the production rollout until we have a tokenizer patch that preserves prefix stability or we switch to kvcache strategy that ignores suffix tokens for keys.
maya: thanks. Once revert merges I'll open a postmortem-lite with perf numbers and recommended checks in model-onboard checklist.
rahul: noted — will follow up with logs once telemetry lands in staging.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
